title: Pipe chart: spheres cap the pipe, all remarks fit
description:
The pipe chart now budgets an exact track height between the From/To spheres, tucks the sphere centers onto the shaft ends so the pipe never runs past the caps, and shrinks observation tags to fit every remark in that track — including dense 26-observation runs.

Who is affected: everyone on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Pipe shaft ends at the sphere centers — no more running past the caps.
Track height is budgeted exactly to the panel so nothing clips at the bottom.
Observation tags shrink further on dense runs so all remarks stay visible.
